title: Breakfast on a Tray
style: Italian-style synth-pop, sleek late-night pulse with crisp programmed drums, rounded analog bass, glassy arpeggiated synths and restrained piano accents. Young female lead with a clear, intimate delivery; British English pronunciation, with subtle Italian inflection in phrasing. Build from poised, close-miked verses into a memorable, emotionally charged chorus; add delicate harmony layers and a brief instrumental lift before the final refrain. Polished, cinematic production with warm low end and spacious but controlled vocals.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Last year, in your studio, I stopped mid-sentence
You looked at me, waiting for the shape of it
I asked if I had kissed you then
Would you have turned away or let me in?

You said, “Oh no, I couldn’t,” firm and clear
I watched your brave face hold its ground
Then lunch came back, the story you had trusted me
And how your guard came down

[Pre-Chorus]
For one small moment, I could see
The weight my youth had held for me
You let my hand go, made your lesson plain
I heard the care beneath the pain

[Chorus]
I knew you would, but it wouldn’t be right
To take what you gave me in a vulnerable light
Now, if you want, let the answer be true
I held out my hand, and I waited for you
You called me evil, softly, looking in my eyes
I never looked away, I never told a lie

[Verse 2]
You left my hand suspended there between us
Long enough to make the choice your own
Then you took it, lifted it and kissed it
And every careful wall was overthrown

“You’re evil, Sylvia, and you know it”
Your voice was gentle, but it found its mark
“I wouldn’t have kissed you back,” you told me
“Against my better sense, I’d have gone all the way”

[Pre-Chorus]
I leaned in close enough to feel
The truth become a thing made real
“You’re right,” I said, “I know what I can do”
Then neither of us turned away

[Chorus]
I knew you would, but it wouldn’t be right
To take what you gave me in a vulnerable light
Now, if you want, let the answer be true
I held out my hand, and I waited for you
You called me evil, softly, looking in my eyes
I never looked away, I never told a lie

[Bridge]
That night in Corall Gardens, your modest castle
The first kiss chosen, the clothes set aside
We learned each other slowly, without pretending
No lesson left to teach, no place to hide

[Final Chorus]
I knew you would, and now it feels right
No borrowed courage, no crossed line in the night
You took my hand, and I stayed close to you
The choice was ours, and we both knew
Morning found me making breakfast in your bed
With odds and ends from cupboards I had read
I made a meal from things you didn’t know you had
And watched you smile, still warm from what we shared

[Outro]
Last year, in your studio, I held the question back
This morning, I bring you breakfast on a tray
